sloka: प्रापणे चास्य मन्त्रस्य निवृत्ताः सर्वमन्त्रिणः ।अवश्यम् च मया वाच्यम् यद्दृष्टमथवा श्रुतम् ॥६-१०-२५॥।।
transliteration: prāpaṇe cāsya mantrasya nivṛttāḥ sarvamantriṇaḥ ।avaśyam ca mayā vācyam yaddṛṣṭamathavā śrutam ॥6-10-25॥।।

translations.english: All your ministers have abstained from telling you out of fear of you. I must necessarily tell you (as brother) this which is seen and heard. You may determine that which is justifiable by determining the propriety. It is proper for me to submit to you.
